可以用下面的 SQL 查询“去年 6 月工单数量最少的 3 个产品”：

```sql
SELECT
  d37208_product_class_name AS product_name,
  SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS incident_count
FROM t_data_assistant_incident
WHERE d37208_incident_month = CONCAT(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1, '-06')
GROUP BY d37208_product_class_name
ORDER BY incident_count ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

如果你的日期字段 `d37208_incident_month` 不是 `YYYY-MM` 格式，而是如 `202406`，则可改为：

```sql
SELECT
  d37208_product_class_name AS product_name,
  SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS incident_count
FROM t_data_assistant_incident
WHERE d37208_incident_month = CONCAT(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1, '06')
GROUP BY d37208_product_class_name
ORDER BY incident_count ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
